第32章 施施这孩子确实上进-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

“霍健华不是答应了吗？”

蔡怡农皱了皱眉头。

她没想到霍健华那边会出现意外。

因为在立项之初，李国立便极力推荐霍健华出演徐长卿。

霍健华之前演过《西街少年》，当时李国立是制片人。

再加上其在《天下第一》里面的优秀表演，让李国立非常看好他。

《仙剑三》刚立项，李国立就联系了霍健华，后者表示答应。

“这个.....他只是口头答应。”

李国立支支吾吾没有说太清。

他没想过对方会放鸽子。

“哼。我看是他的公司不愿意他接这个男二号吧！！”

老蔡冷哼一声，直指问题关键。

她可太清楚弯弯那帮人的尿性。

说白了，就是看不起男二号。

总不能让他演男主角吧？

这部剧的男主只有一个，就是胡哥，其他人都不行。

否则拍什么续集？

唐人这个死样子，不拍续集回血，难道开新坑？

谁知道新的IP会不会受到欢迎。

对于现在的唐人来说，他们需要一部必须赚钱的作品。

想来想去，只有仙剑三才能做到这一点。

让霍健华出演男一号风险太大。

唐人这艘岌岌可危的大船不能冒险。

李国立今年正好五十岁，他和蔡怡农十年前一起创立唐人影视这家公司，对这家公司的感情比谁都深。

如今公司濒临崩溃，李国立当然不希望仙剑三出现问题。

“霍健华公司回应是因为档期冲突....”

大概解释了一下具体情况。

湾湾那边有一部电视剧，想要邀请霍健华出演男主角。

这部剧的拍摄日期正好和《仙剑奇侠传三》撞上。

“那你打算怎么办？”

李国立思考了一下，回道：“这样，我先把剧本寄给霍健华，让他了解一下故事剧情，如果他看中这个角色，或许可以说服经纪公司。”

“然后我们这边还要同步找人，多找几个候选者，以防万一。”

“你觉得怎么样？”

蔡怡农闻言轻轻点头：“可以。”

说到找人，突然想起刚才给她打电话的狗东西。

“对了，我这边有个候选者或许适合徐长卿。”

“有照片吗？”

李国立的第一反应是看照片，他和老蔡一样，是一个颜狗。

长得不够帅，没资格演他的戏。

"Didn't Huo Jianhua agree?"

Cai Yinong frowned.

She didn't expect that there would be an accident on Huo Jianhua's side.

Because at the beginning of the project, Li Guoli strongly recommended Huo Jianhua to play Xu Changqing.

Huo Jianhua had previously acted in "West Street Boy", when Li Guoli was the producer.

Coupled with his excellent performance in "The Best in the World", Li Guoli is very optimistic about him.

As soon as the project of "Sword and Sword III" was established, Li Guoli contacted Huo Jianhua, who agreed.

"Well...he just agreed verbally."

Li Guoli hesitated and did not explain clearly.

He never thought that the other party would let go.

"Hmph. I think his company doesn't want him to take on the second male lead!!"

Lao Cai snorted coldly and pointed to the crux of the problem.

She was very aware of the urinal nature of Wanwan's gang.

To put it bluntly, I just look down on the second male lead.

We can't let him play the leading role, right?

There is only one male protagonist in this drama, Brother Hu, and no one else is good.

Otherwise, why make a sequel?

Tang Ren is so dead. If he doesn't make a sequel to restore his health, will he open a new hole?

Who knows if the new IP will be popular.

For the current Tang people, they need a work that must make money.

After much deliberation, only Fairy Sword III can do this.

It is too risky to let Huo Jianhua play the male lead.

The precarious ship of the Tang Dynasty cannot be risked.

Li Guoli is exactly 50 years old this year. He and Cai Yinong founded Tangren Film and Television together ten years ago, and they have a deeper affection for this company than anyone else.

Now that the company is on the verge of collapse, Li Guoli certainly does not want Xian Jian San to have problems.

"Huo Jianhua's company responded that it was due to schedule conflicts..."

Briefly explain the specific situation.

There is a TV series over there in Wanwan, and they want to invite Huo Jianhua to play the leading role.

The filming date of this drama coincides with "Legend of Sword and Fairy III".

"Then what are you going to do?"

Li Guoli thought for a while and replied: "In this case, I will send the script to Huo Jianhua first and let him understand the plot of the story. If he likes this role, he may be able to convince the agency."

"Then we have to find people here simultaneously and find a few more candidates, just in case."

"What do you think?"

Cai Yinong nodded slightly when he heard this: "Okay."

Speaking of finding someone, she suddenly remembered the dog who called her just now.

"By the way, I have a candidate here who may be suitable for Xu Changqing."

"Do you have any photos?"

Li Guoli's first reaction was to look at the photo. Like Lao Cai, he is a handsome person.

He's not handsome enough to play his role.
